title: Carbazole appended trans-dicationic pyridinium porphyrin finds supremacy in DNA binding/photocleavage over a non-carbazolyl analogue.
authors: Das, Athulya; Mohammed, Thasnim P; Kumar, Rajesh; Bhunia, Sarmistha; Sankaralingam, Muniyandi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究咔唑卟啉衍生物与CT-DNA的结合及光切割，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但对象为小分子-DNA，非TF-DNA，且方法仅含实验与简单对接，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: A carbazolyl appended trans-pyridyl porphyrin (1) was synthesized and its dicationic form 2 was obtained by methylation of the pyridyl group. Copper and zinc complexes of porphyrin 2 (Cu(II), 3; Zn(II), 4) were isolated and characterized by various modern spectroscopic techniques. The DNA binding properties of 2, 3, and 4 have been explored against calf thymus-DNA (CT-DNA). DNA binding was quantized using the intrinsic binding constant (K(b)) that was calculated by UV-visible absorption spectroscopy, and the value K(b) = 1.6 x 10(6) M(-1) for compound 2 reveals a better interaction of 2 towards CT-DNA than those of 3 (3.1 x 10(5) M(-1)) and 4 (3.4 x 10(5) M(-1)), which follows the order 2 > 4 > 3. The fluorescence quenching efficiency and ethidium bromide quenching assay also indicated a good binding affinity of all the compounds towards CT-DNA. Furthermore, the spectroscopic data suggest that the possible mode of interaction is intercalation. The docking studies were in accordance with the experimental results. Notably, DNA cleavage studies reveal that 2 shows better damage than 3 and 4 which is in accordance with the binding affinity order 2 > 4 > 3. The observed quantum yield (2: 0.65, 3: 0.33, and 4: 0.97) and no change in DNA cleavage in the presence of NaN(3) reveal the involvement of singlet oxygen. The singlet excited state lifetimes were in the range of 6.3-1.2 ns. Furthermore, these porphyrins can be investigated as interesting photosensitizers in photodynamic therapy and photochemotherapy.
abstract_zh: 合成了一种咔唑基连接的反式吡啶基卟啉（1），并通过吡啶基的甲基化获得其二价阳离子形式2。分离了卟啉2的铜和锌配合物（Cu(II)，3；Zn(II)，4），并使用多种现代光谱技术对其进行了表征。研究了2、3和4对小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的DNA结合性质。通过紫外-可见吸收光谱计算的内在结合常数（K(b)）对DNA结合进行了定量，化合物2的K(b)值为1.6 x 10(6) M(-1)，表明2对CT-DNA的相互作用优于3（3.1 x 10(5) M(-1)）和4（3.4 x 10(5) M(-1)），顺序为2 > 4 > 3。荧光猝灭效率和溴化乙锭猝灭实验也表明所有化合物对CT-DNA具有良好的结合亲和力。此外，光谱数据表明可能的相互作用模式是嵌入。对接研究结果与实验结果一致。值得注意的是，DNA切割研究表明，2的损伤程度优于3和4，这与结合亲和力顺序2 > 4 > 3一致。观察到的量子产率（2：0.65，3：0.33，4：0.97）以及在NaN(3)存在下DNA切割无变化，揭示了单线态氧的参与。单线激发态寿命在6.3-1.2 ns范围内。此外，这些卟啉可作为光动力疗法和光化学疗法中有趣的光敏剂进行研究。
